name: Primal Construct Component
desc: Commissioned by Nahida and Grand Sage Naphis, Alhaitham and Kaveh are undertaking an urgent project. As the next phase requires a vast supply of materials, they have turned to the Primal Constructs within The Mausoleum of King Deshret as the ideal source. Their ancient technology and high-grade components will be dismantled into microscopic parts, then reconfigured for a new environment.

value.name: A Tower Unto Wisdom and Folly
value.desc: The current crisis is now beyond the capacity of ordinary men, and an unprecedented war is about to begin in the nation of wisdom. But even so, no one is abandoning their post.
